data.long_meaning: The one who is devoted to and loves Allah, the Almighty and Merciful. The name Chashida carries the meaning “Love of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Chashida usually hope their child will grow to embody love of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

By carrying this name, one is encouraged to strive for a constant remembrance of Allah and to lead a God-conscious life. It is a name given with the intention of nurturing a relationship with the Divine, fostering a sense of devotion and self-growth.
